name: admakeai
title: AdMake AI - AI Ad Creative Platform
description: AdMake AI generates Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ad images and UGC-style video ads from a product photo or text prompt, tracks competitor ads from the Meta Ad Library, and publishes finished ads to Meta through the official Marketing API. This card describes how AI agents can discover and connect to AdMake AI's live MCP server.

servers.name: admakeai

authentication.description: Two options. Clients that speak the MCP authorization spec (for example Claude custom connectors) use OAuth 2.1: an unauthenticated request returns 401 with a WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata pointer, dynamic client registration is open, and the authorization-code flow with S256 PKCE issues a scoped token. Everything else uses an AdMake AI API key created at /dashboard/integrations/api; keys are revocable and may have an expiry.

scopes.mcp:read: Read the account, projects, generated ads, and Facebook ad performance.
scopes.mcp:write: Generate ads, upload images, and prepare campaign drafts. Spends credits.
scopes.mcp:publish: Push drafts live and pause or resume Facebook campaigns, ad sets, and ads.

oauth.note: Tools are filtered by granted scope: a connection approved without mcp:publish cannot even list the live-action tools.

notes: Tool names are tRPC procedure paths with dots replaced by double underscores, for example adGeneration.create becomes adGeneration__create.
Input schemas are served over the standard MCP tools/list call.
No delete operations are exposed. Tools marked dangerous create or change real Meta ads and require explicit user confirmation before calling.
Meta ad, ad set, and campaign pause/resume tools are registered but currently disabled and fail closed; use Meta Ads Manager for status changes.
The same tool allowlist is available over REST at https://admakeai.com/api/v1 with the same API key. Human-readable reference: https://admakeai.com/api/docs.

tools.name: user__me
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile, plan, and credit balance.

tools.name: user__getCredits
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's current credit balance.

tools.name: upload__uploadImageBase64
tools.description: Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image from base64 bytes into AdMake AI storage. Returns an image ID and public URL for use in generation or campaign drafts.

tools.name: upload__getUserImages
tools.description: List previously uploaded source images, newest first, with pagination.

tools.name: adGeneration__create
tools.description: Create a new ad image generation from a text prompt and optional product image. Returns a generation ID to poll with adGeneration__getById.

tools.name: adGeneration__getById
tools.description: Get the status, prompt, and resulting image URLs of a single ad generation. Poll until status is COMPLETED.

tools.name: adGeneration__list
tools.description: Paginated list of the user's ad generations, newest first.

tools.name: adGeneration__getRecent
tools.description: Get the user's most recent ad generations (default limit 12).

tools.name: adGeneration__searchAll
tools.description: Full-text search across the user's ad generations by prompt.

tools.name: adGeneration__listPending
tools.description: List the user's currently pending ad generations.

tools.name: adSet__list
tools.description: Paginated list of the user's ad sets.

tools.name: adSet__get
tools.description: Get an ad set by ID, including its general instructions.

tools.name: adSet__getGenerations
tools.description: List all ad generations belonging to an ad set.

tools.name: adSet__generateBatch
tools.description: Generate a batch of ad variations from one ad set plus per-variation instructions. Enqueues background jobs and returns their generation IDs.

tools.name: adResearch__listProjects
tools.description: List the user's research and ad-generation projects.

tools.name: facebookConnection__list
tools.description: List the user's connected Facebook ad accounts and Pages.

tools.name: facebookUpload__getCampaigns
tools.description: List Meta campaigns for a specific connected ad account.

tools.name: facebookUpload__getAdSets
tools.description: List Meta ad sets under a given campaign.

tools.name: facebookUpload__runPreflight
tools.description: Validate an ad creative and ad account pair for Meta upload (image dimensions, copy length) without uploading.

tools.name: facebookUpload__request
tools.description: Upload an AdMake AI generated ad creative to a Meta ad account, campaign, and ad set. Creates a real ad on Meta; always confirm with the user first.

tools.name: facebookUpload__list
tools.description: List previously uploaded ads, filterable by ad account and state.

tools.name: facebookUpload__get
tools.description: Get the upload state and Meta IDs of a single uploaded ad.

tools.name: facebookCampaignDraft__sourceAssets
tools.description: Resolve previously uploaded Meta ads into reusable creative assets for a campaign draft.

tools.name: facebookCampaignDraft__getAgentDraft
tools.description: Read a saved agent-created Facebook campaign draft by draft ID before pushing.

tools.name: facebookCampaignDraft__pushAgentDraft
tools.description: Push a saved agent-created Facebook campaign draft to Meta as draft campaigns, ad sets, and ads. Always confirm with the user first.

tools.name: facebookCampaignDraft__pushDraftCampaign
tools.description: Create Meta draft campaigns, ad sets, and ads from explicit campaign data, ad copy, and image URLs. Supports externally hosted image URLs. Always confirm with the user first.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__tree
tools.description: Get the campaign, ad set, and ad hierarchy for an ad account.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__timeline
tools.description: Get time-series performance metrics for an ad account.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__listCampaigns
tools.description: List Meta campaigns with rolled-up performance metrics.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__listAds
tools.description: List Meta ads under a campaign or ad set with performance metrics.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__getAd
tools.description: Get a single Meta ad's metadata and creative.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__getAdAnalytics
tools.description: Get day-by-day analytics (spend, CTR, CPC, conversions) for a single Meta ad.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__pauseAd
tools.description: Currently disabled; Meta ad status changes fail closed. Use Meta Ads Manager.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__resumeAd
tools.description: Currently disabled; Meta ad status changes fail closed. Use Meta Ads Manager.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__pauseCampaign
tools.description: Currently disabled; Meta campaign status changes fail closed. Use Meta Ads Manager.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__resumeCampaign
tools.description: Currently disabled; Meta campaign status changes fail closed. Use Meta Ads Manager.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__pauseAdSet
tools.description: Currently disabled; Meta ad set status changes fail closed. Use Meta Ads Manager.

tools.name: zernioAnalytics__resumeAdSet
tools.description: Currently disabled; Meta ad set status changes fail closed. Use Meta Ads Manager.
